…
Walking through the city at this hour made me realize how little of a difference there is between day and night.
Back in my small town everyone would be asleep by now, but here?
In some parts life is booming as bright as during the day, or even more.
Well, there is much less vomiting while the sun is still up.
When I first went out at night here, it was quite a shock for me. All these people clubbing, enjoying the night.
‘That’s awesome!’ I thought at first and started going out myself with, at the time, my college friends.
We had a lot of fun, including a few incidents, but I quickly realized that drinking all night and then going to lectures isn’t my cup of tea. Some people would pull it off, but I couldn’t.
Lack of willpower, or maybe just being lightweight, whatever it was, I couldn’t keep up with both drinking and studying.
When problems at college grew bigger and bigger I needed to focus on studying and stop partying so much.
People I then thought to be my friends quickly found new colleagues to drink with and I ended up alone with piles of books and assignments to catch up with. Yeah, I think that was the point when the rift between me and my ex started to grow. 
I guess only my father’s death kept her around for longer…{{wi}} She probably didn’t want to end up with a reputation of a cold bitch.
If she broke up with me soon after a thing like that, people on campus wouldn’t give her a break, no matter what real circumstances could have been.
They just can’t help themselves but assume things.
I wonder when she met her new guy. For sure she was hanging out with him before our breakup!
Agh… {{wi}}I’m getting mad again. I went for a walk to relax, but instead my head is full of stupid thoughts and memories I would rather forget…
